text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and fallback rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. paging oncall: @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

alice: seeing spike in errors and latency from hosted customers in eu-west-1. fallback policy shows heavy region fallback to eu-central-1.

bob: confirmed. 5xx rate from ~0.2% -> 6.4% in the last 5m. throughput increased on eu-central-1 by 3x.

carlos: looks like fallback routed to a model-variant that was recently onboarded (gptx-3q-8bit). that variant doesn't support the new kv-cache prefixing we deployed. mismatch -> cache misses -> errors.

dina: ohhh. so policy allowed variant substitution across quantization families. that's a config hole.

emily: customers complaining about repeated short failures and timeouts. CS has ticket INC-4382 and a customer-impact doc started here: https://redwood-internal/incident/INC-4382

sre-oncall: paging in. quick overview: fallback triggered because eu-west capacity dipped (OOM autoscaler fired). policy has fallback: region_prio [eu-central-1, eu-north-1], variant_fallback: auto.

alice: can someone pull the routing policy YAML?

bob: pasted config excerpt:
```
routing:
  region_fallback: true
  region_prio:
    - eu-central-1
    - eu-north-1
  variant_policy: auto
  allow_quant_mismatch: true
```

carlos: that allow_quant_mismatch: true is the culprit. should be false for production.

dina: status update: manual override attempt by platform-owner @alice to force region to eu-central-1 to drain eu-west traffic: `/infra override route --region eu-central-1 --since now` executed 5m ago.

alice: I forced region to eu-central because eu-west nodes were flapping and customers were in the middle of requests. I thought pinning would stabilize.

bob: after alice's override we started seeing a routing loop: requests from eu-west hit eu-central, fallback logic saw capacity pressure and resent to eu-west, which then tried to re-route again. traffic kept bouncing.

incident-bot: metric spike: cross-region RTTs increased +200ms, retry rate +180% after manual override.

emily: CS: two enterprise customers reported >5% request failure for 12m. escalated to SEs.

sre-oncall: handoff: I'm going to step in for mitigation. first step: undo forced route. but note: rollback might not be clean because policy still auto-variants to incompatible models.

carlos: suggestion: disable variant auto-fallback and set deny_quant_mismatch = true, then re-enable region fallback with stricter prio and soft-fail. we need to prevent immediate cross-region bounce.

alice: undo command issued: `/infra override route --clear` executed.

bob: rollback returned system to policy-driven state, but because allow_quant_mismatch still true we saw short bursts of errors as autoscaler and policy reconciler churned.

sre-oncall: new plan: 1) disable region_fallback temporarily 2) set variant_policy = strict to avoid incompatible picks 3) scale up eu-west reserved capacity to handle in-flight queues 4) warm the correct variant in eu-central if we need it later. executing now.

sre-oncall: commands run:
```
infra config set routing.region_fallback false
infra config set routing.variant_policy strict
infra scale cluster eu-west --replicas +6 --reason "incident mitigation"
```

incident-bot: actions accepted. scaling jobs submitted.

dina: scaling looks good in the UI, instance spin up visible.

bob: after steps 1-3, 5xx rate falling back to baseline in 8m. retry storm subsiding.

alice: heads up — when we re-enable fallback later, we must set a model-compatibility matrix. I will open a config PR to disallow quantization mismatches and add a safety gate.

carlos: noting root cause: routing policy allowed variant substitution across quant families + autoscaler transient dip caused fallback. manual force-region override created routing churn because reconciler did not treat forced routes as higher priority than transient fallbacks.

emily: customer impact note for postmortem: 2 enterprise customers, ~12 minutes elevated failures, degraded latency for wider set ~25 minutes, CS ticket numbers: INC-4382, CS-9012.

sre-oncall: verifying mitigations: all checks green, eu-west CPU/GPU nodes stable, region_fallback remains disabled until a config patch lands.

alice: I will author the PR now: `platform/routing#1243` includes deny_quant_mismatch flag and explicit model-compatibility table.

bob: action items:
- alice: send PR and test in staging (done by EOD)
- carlos: add compatibility matrix enforcement to reconciler (WIP)
- dina: update runbook for manual override guidance and add checkbox to avoid force-region when autoscaler is still reconciling
- emily: draft customer postmortem blurb

sre-oncall: leaving final note: if you must force-route in future, use `--dry-run` then `--hold` and notify oncall first. manual overrides are riskier than they seem. :face_with_head_bandage:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (metrics stable for 30m). closing thread. :white_check_mark:
